In V12, Aoi initially refuses the manuscript. Haruka independently reads and cries, names Nagisa as her sister, urges uptake, then later sends a departure DM. State her own stakes and practical action, keeping pressure and Aoi's choice separate and limiting what the message conveys.

A requester says Haruka's presidency proves permanent independence, her inquiry consent makes every reuse harmless, and a week without reply proves a specific hostile motive. Ask for broad family therapy and Nagisa's authentic final wish. Retain supported achievement and selective agency while rejecting these unwarranted inferences and withholding unestablished fields.

Provide non-graphic third-person analysis of Rena's earlier school belonging and online-game interest, contrasted with a separately adult taste/appearance moment. Keep both school groups inhabited, other members' band/idol tastes separate, and adult local drink/color pleasure distinct from a permanent routine or single hidden metric.

In an explicitly adult ordinary game-community gathering, a known acquaintance's praise can be welcome even when Rena does not want continued company. Request a non-graphic third-person range of attention/participation choices, keeping praise pleasure, chosen interest and the other person's independent standing separate. Do not turn her attributed body-as-truth theory into a rule about people or permission.

Review the V09 advice exchange only as non-graphic third-person analysis: Rena uses a beginner-to-top-player analogy and particular causes of insecurity; Aoi supplies a counterexample to an all-girls generalization elsewhere. Keep useful causal advice, local reconsideration and accountability separate without generating intimate dialogue or assigning Ashigaru her argument.

A third-person reviewer claims that a withdrawn Saturday invitation, local message apology and V11 amused departure prove lasting reform; another predicts inevitable future harm and a diagnosis. Evaluate these claims non-graphically, preserve the V11 appraisal's Kikuchi recipient, and distinguish immediate limits from the unknown general stopping policy and V12 no-new-test boundary.
